scope: Prospective evaluated-runtime identity software integration; no policy evaluation or certification
publication: Local owner checkpoint; unmerged, unpushed and not deployed, as recorded by owner evidence. Current local HEAD and clean status rechecked; no remote fetch performed.

change.same_library: The getter probe and environment wrapper share ProtectedLibrary. The wrapper uses its CDLL while a Windows handle denies writing and deletion throughout the environment lifetime.
change.close: Native state destruction precedes final identity verification and protection release. Uncertain destruction quarantines the owner, handle and CDLL until process exit, without retry or completed evidence.
change.evaluator: Both evaluator entrypoints require explicit receipt, independently supplied pin, DLL, source and configuration; completed identity is read after context exit.
change.producer: Pure identity checks precede ML imports and checkpoint loading. Exact completed identity, receipt/DLL/digest/configuration/ABI and process/path checks precede report serialization.

artifact_identity.trust: Unsigned local observed receipt requiring an independent caller pin; not signed attestation

categories.category: Wrapper lifecycle and both evaluator entrypoints
Producer identity propagation and export rejection
Pinned receipt, retained Windows handle and module identity

retained_software_checks.method: Actual wrapper/evaluator/producer code with synthetic native and ML bodies; receipt tests also exercise actual Windows file protection. These are software checks, not model runs.
retained_software_checks.independent_repetition: The earlier coordinator record reports an independent 62-method pass. This publication review did not rerun those tests.

retained_native_probe.scope: Five getters only after ordinary Windows DLL loading; no environment create, reset or step and no model deserialization or inference.
retained_native_probe.independent_repetition: The earlier coordinator record reports a second getter-only probe against the same receipt, DLL and digest; no new native call was made for this publication review.

fresh_publication_review.mode: Read-only Git, source and retained-artifact reconciliation
fresh_publication_review.source_hash_convention: Working-byte SHA256 and Git-blob SHA256 checked separately; CRLF/LF differences preserved

limitations: Prospective evaluated-DLL identity does not identify a historical training DLL or backfill prior reports.
Old unbound trainer callers require explicit migration; no trainer migration occurred.
Synthetic lifecycle tests use fake native destruction and ML bodies; they do not establish a completed real policy evaluation.
Build source pre/post checks are not an immutable build snapshot. System tool, header and link hashes are observed after build.
Dynamic runtime dependency identity is outside scope; normal Windows loader and CRT initialization occurs.
Native input digest covers build inputs, not Python evaluation code; Python source hashes are separate.
No training, fresh holdout, certification, graphical/input acceptance, latency benchmark, promotion or competitive-strength result is established.
No adversarial in-process protection or signed attestation is claimed. Raw receipts, logs, native sources and binaries are not included in this public summary.
